name: TPC Four Seasons Las Colinas
_comment_tees: Scorecard from GolfPass (15024, TPC Las Colinas); OpenStreetMap's hole lines have no par tags, but their lengths match the card's Byron Nelson tees (par 70). Six of its nine tees kept. Its tee table rates other lengths; ratings only where close: Byron Nelson = its Black (7166), White (5836), Red = Red (W) (5030, the women's).
_comment_drop: Polygons containing these points are not part of the course: an OSM bunker on grass by #12 (trim_far.py drops the range and practice greens).
_comment_shift: OSM outlines sit this many metres off the Esri imagery; every point is moved by it (fitted to the bunkers on sand; the greens agree).
